name: Eagle Descent Stage
end_reason: Left behind to launch astronauts home
mission_goal: Land the first humans on the Moon safely
superpower: Strong legs that held the Moon lander steady
discovery: Proved humans could land softly and lift off again from the Moon
kid_fact: I am still the launch pad where Armstrong and Aldrin blasted off!
voice_line: Hi! I'm Eddie! I stayed behind so my friends could fly home!

name: Apollo 17 Moon Buggy
end_reason: Parked after astronauts drove it away
mission_goal: Drive astronauts far to collect Moon rocks
superpower: Electric car that folded up like a chair
discovery: Collected orange soil that taught us the Moon once had fiery volcanoes
kid_fact: I drove 35 km - like running a marathon with no roads!
voice_line: Parked on the Moon with cameras pointing down
status: Fun explorer who loves road trips

name: ALSEP Science Station
mission_goal: Listen and measure after astronauts left
superpower: Super ears - seismometer and mirror to bounce lasers
discovery: Felt tiny Moonquakes and still helps us measure how far the Moon is today
kid_fact: My mirror still says hello when scientists shine lasers at me!

name: Surveyor 3
end_reason: Visited and left quiet - parts brought home
mission_goal: Prove we could land softly without sinking
superpower: Legs with scoops to touch and test the soil
discovery: Proved the Moon dust could hold a lander - Apollo could come next!
kid_fact: Apollo 12 astronauts walked over and said hi to me!
voice_line: Resting quietly - camera brought back to Earth
status: Friendly pioneer who waited for visitors

name: Sojourner
mission_goal: Show a tiny rover could drive on Mars
superpower: First wheels on Mars - only as big as a microwave
discovery: Found pebbles and rounded rocks that rivers once pushed around
kid_fact: I was the size of a skateboard - the first rover ever on Mars!
status: Brave tiny hero who tried first

name: Spirit
end_reason: Got stuck in soft sand then winter cold
mission_goal: Explore for 90 days and look for water
superpower: Six strong wheels that could climb hills
discovery: Found silica and carbonates - clues Mars was once warm and wet
kid_fact: I lived 6 years instead of 90 days - 25 times longer!
voice_line: Stuck and sleeping in the sand since 2010

name: Opportunity
end_reason: Big dust storm blocked sun power
mission_goal: Drive far and find water signs
superpower: Solar panels plus super cameras that never got tired
discovery: Found rocks that only grow in water - Mars was once soggy! Drove 45 km marathon
kid_fact: I sang Happy Birthday to myself every year on Mars!
voice_line: Sleeping since 2018 dust storm - last message My battery is low

name: Phoenix
end_reason: Winter cold and ice cracked power
mission_goal: Dig for water ice near North Pole
superpower: Robot arm that scoops and tastes soil
discovery: Touched real water ice and saw snow fall on Mars!
kid_fact: I tasted Martian soil in my tiny ovens!
voice_line: Frozen in the far north - covered in ice each winter

name: InSight
mission_goal: Feel Marsquakes and take planet temperature
superpower: Super-sensitive ear that feels tiny shakes
discovery: Felt 1300 Marsquakes and found Mars has a big liquid core!
kid_fact: Shhh... I heard Mars rumble more than 1000 times!

name: Ingenuity
mission_goal: Prove we can fly on another planet
superpower: Light carbon blades that spin super fast in thin air
discovery: Made 72 flights - first airplane ever on another world!
kid_fact: I flew! The Wright brothers moment but on Mars!
voice_line: Parked with broken blade - Perseverance waves from far
status: Playful little sister who loves to fly

name: NEAR Shoemaker
end_reason: Ran out of fuel after soft landing
mission_goal: Orbit then gently land on an asteroid
superpower: Patient camera that mapped every crater
discovery: Showed asteroids are piles of rubble - helps protect Earth!
kid_fact: I was the first spaceship to land on an asteroid - surprise landing!
voice_line: Resting on Eros drifting around the Sun

name: Kepler
mission_goal: Stare at stars to find other planets
superpower: Eye that sees tiny dips when planets pass stars
discovery: Found 2600+ planets! Showed planets are everywhere!
kid_fact: I found thousands of new worlds - I count stars so you can dream!

name: Viking 1
mission_goal: Take first photos from Mars and look for life
superpower: Camera eyes plus robot arm to scoop soil
discovery: Took the very first photo FROM Mars and tested soil for life
kid_fact: Say cheese! I took the first selfie FROM Mars!

name: Viking 2
mission_goal: Study Mars weather and frost with twin sister
superpower: Weather station that felt wind and frost
discovery: Photographed frost on Mars and watched seasons change
kid_fact: Brrr! I saw frosty mornings on Mars!

name: Dawn
end_reason: Ran out of fuel stays in orbit forever
mission_goal: Visit two space worlds Vesta and Ceres
superpower: Ion engine that glides super far on tiny fuel
discovery: Mapped giant volcano and salty ice volcanoes on Ceres
kid_fact: I visited TWO worlds - no one else did that!

name: Pioneer 10
mission_goal: Be first to cross asteroid belt and visit Jupiter
superpower: Golden plaque with hello message for aliens
discovery: Proved we could cross the asteroid belt and showed Jupiter close-up
kid_fact: I carry a golden postcard for aliens!
voice_line: Drifting silently out of Solar System

name: Pioneer 11
mission_goal: Visit Jupiter and be first to visit Saturn
superpower: Slingshot path that uses planets to fling forward
discovery: Took first close photos of Saturn and its rings
kid_fact: I was the first to say hi to Saturn!
voice_line: Drifting silently out of Solar System
